title: Indian Rupee gives back early gains, UN General Assembly is key event
summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens higher again versus the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday but later gives back its early gains. The USD/INR pair flattens at around 95.82 ahead of meeting between leaders from the United States (US) and Gulf nations regarding the energy supply through the Middle East.

title: British Pound: Oversold slide nears 1.3335 against US Dollar – UOB
summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann remain negative on GBP/USD after the pair eased to around 1.3370. They expect a test of last week’s low near 1.3335, though a sustained break below that level and the major 1.3300 support is seen as unlikely.

title: Sunrise Market Commmentary
summary: Markets US stock markets rallied up 2.26% (Nasdaq) yesterday with AI/tech names leading the advance. The Nasdaq even tested the all-time high reached early June. The likes of the S P 500 and EuroStoxx50 recovered up to 1.5%. Positive risk vibes and lower energy prices supported consolidation on bond markets following the past month s heavy losses. title: Euro rises against Japanese Yen as latter underperforms across board
summary: The Euro (EUR) is 0.2% at around 180.78 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The cross gains as the Japanese currency underperforms its currency peers.

title: Hungarian Forint: MNB pause supports HUF – Commerzbank
summary: Antje Praefcke at Commerzbank highlights that the Hungarian Central Bank is widely expected to leave its key rate at 5.50% and possibly lower its inflation target to 2.5%.
